item.description: DOÑA ANA COUNTY, N.M. (KRQE) – Early Sunday morning, Doña Ana Fire Rescue and Las Cruces Fire responded to a large house fire in Doña Ana. item.title: Statewide Farmers' Market Nutrition Program begins
item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – Starting Sunday, income-eligible seniors can apply for the Farmers' Market Nutrition Program. This seasonal program is provided by the Department of Health, connecting seniors and families with local growers to provide fresh produce. Last year, over 600 farmers participated, helping nearly 28,000 seniors access these benefits. Those interested can apply online or [...]

item.title: Warm and windy weather move into New Mexico this week
item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – Partly cloudy skies moved into parts of New Mexico today as warmer temperatures returned as well. Partly cloudy skies will persist overnight tonight and through the majority of the week. South-southwesterly upper-level winds continue to increase to start the week. item.description: ROSWELL, N.M. (KRQE) – It was a heartwarming reunion for soldiers with the National Guard as they returned to their families this Valentine's Day. item.title: Volantis twirls gem in season debut, Texas sweeps UC Davis
item.description: Volantis mowed through the UC Davis lineup, allowing one hit with eight strikeouts in seven innings in a 9-1 Texas win to sweep the Aggies on UFCU Disch-Falk Field. An unearned run crossed the plate in the sixth inning, but he needed just 78 pitches to get through his outing before Michael Winter worked the final two frames.

item.title: New Mexico Highlands University urges legislators to back bill improving campus sports facilities
item.description: A university in Northeastern New Mexico is hoping to secure 80 million dollars from the state, during the last few days of this legislative session, hoping to improve what they call 'sub-standard' sports facilities on campus.
